lists.name: php
lists.info: 在 Ubuntu Rootfs 中独立安装并运行 PHP CLI，wwwroot 目录会被php、python环境共用，卸载单个环境时不会删除目录本身，只清理自身文件。

install.command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update && apt-get install -y php-cli && mkdir -p '/storage/emulated/0/WebHTV/wwwroot' && printf '%s\n' '<?php echo "Hello from Ubuntu PHP " . PHP_VERSION;' > '/storage/emulated/0/WebHTV/wwwroot/index.php' && touch '{package_dir}/.installed'
install.uninstall_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; __p=$(dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^i/ || $1=="rc" {print $2}' | grep -E '^php' | tr '\n' ' '); echo "[lab] 待卸载 php 包: ${__p:-（无）}"; [ -n "$__p" ] && apt-get purge -y $__p; apt-get autoremove -y; rm -f '/storage/emulated/0/WebHTV/wwwroot/index.php'; rm -f '{package_dir}/.installed'; if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[lab] php 仍在 rootfs，卸载未完成'; false; else echo '[lab] php 已从 rootfs 移除'; true; fi
install.reset_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; __p=$(dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^i/ || $1=="rc" {print $2}' | grep -E '^php' | tr '\n' ' '); [ -n "$__p" ] && apt-get purge -y $__p; apt-get autoremove -y >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f '{package_dir}/.installed'; true

commands.description:
修改 AList 配置文件config.json里的端口：
"scheme": {
    "address": "0.0.0.0",
    "http_port": 5244,    // ← 就改这个数字}
修改后操作说明：
键盘的 方向键（↑↓←→） 移动光标到 "http_port": 5244 ，

lists.name: tgautodown
lists.info: 一款用于下载TG上视频、音乐、图片、文档、磁力链的TG机器人；只需将所需的资源转发给机器人，机器人会自动完成下载，并且会在完成后回复消息通知你。

commands.name: 🎵第一步：TG音乐转存初始化(必须)
commands.description: 创建 /boot/tgautodown/目录并克隆项目并编译二进制文件，给予可执行权限，为后续运行做准备！
commands.command: export http_proxy={proxy_addr} https_proxy={proxy_addr}; mkdir -p /boot/tgautodown/ && cd /boot/tgautodown/; if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'git already installed'; else apt -o Acquire::http::Proxy={proxy_addr} -o Acquire::https::Proxy={proxy_addr} update && apt -o Acquire::http::Proxy={proxy_addr} -o Acquire::https::Proxy={proxy_addr} install -y git; fi; REQUIRED_GO_VERSION=1.23.4; if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then CURRENT_GO_VERSION=$(go version | awk '{print $3}' | sed 's/go//'); if dpkg --compare-versions "$CURRENT_GO_VERSION" ge "$REQUIRED_GO_VERSION"; then echo 'go version OK'; else echo 'go version too old, installing new'; apt remove -y golang-go golang-1.22 golang-src golang-doc 2>/dev/null || true; INSTALL_GO=true; fi; else echo 'go not installed'; INSTALL_GO=true; fi; if [ "$INSTALL_GO" = true ]; then ARCH=$(uname -m); case $ARCH in x86_64) GOARCH=amd64;; aarch64) GOARCH=arm64;; armv7l|armv8l) GOARCH=armv6l;; *) echo 'Unsupported arch'; exit 1;; esac; GO_VERSION=1.23.4; URL=https://go.dev/dl/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-${GOARCH}.tar.gz; if command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then wget -O /tmp/go.tar.gz "$URL"; elif command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -L "$URL" -o /tmp/go.tar.gz; else echo 'Need wget or curl'; exit 1; fi; rm -rf /usr/local/go; tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/go.tar.gz; export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH; fi; rm -rf tgautodown && git clone https://github.com/nasbump/tgautodown.git && cd tgautodown && export CGO_ENABLED=0 && export GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct && go build -o tgautodown . && chmod +x tgautodown

lists.name: tingreader
lists.info: Ting Reader（听悦）轻量级自托管有声书平台，后端 Rust 重写。支持自动刮削元数据、多端播放进度同步、沉浸式播放（跳过片头片尾）、书架/收藏/搜索、后台管理。二进制运行于 Ubuntu Rootfs /boot/ting-reader/，数据目录在外部存储 /storage/emulated/0/WebHTV/ting-reader/。

commands.name: 📥第一步：下载安装(必须)
commands.description: 下载 Ting Reader 后端(arm64)+前端到 /boot/ting-reader/ 并解压，生成 config.toml（端口3001），幂等：已存在则跳过下载
commands.command:
export V=1.5.9; mkdir -p /boot/ting-reader/ {tingreader_dir}/data {tingreader_dir}/temp {tingreader_dir}/storage; cd /boot/ting-reader/; if [ ! -f ting-reader ]; then curl -fL --retry 3 -o backend.tar.gz https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/dqsq2e2/ting-reader/releases/download/v${V}/ting-reader-backend-linux-arm64-${V}.tar.gz && curl -fL --retry 3 -o frontend.tar.gz https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/dqsq2e2/ting-reader/releases/download/v${V}/ting-reader-frontend-${V}.tar.gz && tar -xzf backend.tar.gz && tar -xzf frontend.tar.gz && chmod +x ting-reader && rm -f backend.tar.gz frontend.tar.gz; fi; mkdir -p plugins preinstalled-plugins logs; if [ -d preinstalled-plugins ]; then cp -a preinstalled-plugins/. /boot/ting-reader/preinstalled-plugins/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi; cat > config.toml <<'CFG'
version = "1.5.9"

[server]
host = "0.0.0.0"
port = {port}
max_connections = 100
request_timeout = 30

[database]
path = "{tingreader_dir}/data/ting-reader.db"
connection_pool_size = 10
busy_timeout = 30000

[plugins]
plugin_dir = "/boot/ting-reader/plugins"
preinstalled_dir = "/boot/ting-reader/preinstalled-plugins"
enable_hot_reload = true
max_memory_per_plugin = 536870912
max_execution_time = 300

[task_queue]
max_concurrent_tasks = 10
default_retry_count = 3
task_timeout = 600

[logging]
level = "info"
format = "json"
output = "stdout"
log_file = "/boot/ting-reader/logs/ting-reader.log"
max_file_size = 10485760
max_backups = 5

[security]
enable_auth = false
api_key = ""
allowed_origins = ["*"]
rate_limit_requests = 100
rate_limit_window = 60
enable_hsts = false
hsts_max_age = 31536000

[storage]
data_dir = "{tingreader_dir}/data"
temp_dir = "{tingreader_dir}/temp"
local_storage_root = "{tingreader_dir}/storage"
local_library_roots = []
max_disk_usage = 2147483648

[audio]
cache_enabled = true
cache_size = 104857600
buffer_size = 65536
